# Authoritex v3.1.1 - Table of Contents

An Elixir library for searching and fetching controlled vocabulary authority terms

## Pages

- [Introduction](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Livebook Notebook](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/livebook.md)
- [License](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Authoritex](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.md): Elixir authority lookup behavior
- [Authoritex.FAST](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology
- [Authoritex.FAST.Base](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.Base.md): Abstract Authoritex implementation for FAST authorities & vocabularies
- [Authoritex.FAST.CorporateName](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.CorporateName.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology -- Corporate Name
- [Authoritex.FAST.EventName](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.EventName.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology -- Event Name
- [Authoritex.FAST.Form](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.Form.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology -- Form/Genre
- [Authoritex.FAST.Geographic](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.Geographic.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology -- Geographic
- [Authoritex.FAST.Personal](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.Personal.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology -- Personal
- [Authoritex.FAST.Topical](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.Topical.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology -- Topical
- [Authoritex.FAST.UniformTitle](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.FAST.UniformTitle.md): Authoritex implementation for Faceted Application of Subject Terminology -- Uniform Title
- [Authoritex.GeoNames](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.GeoNames.md): Authoritex implementation for GeoNames webservice
- [Authoritex.Getty](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.Getty.md): Authoritex implementation for the Getty Vocabularies
- [Authoritex.Getty.AAT](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.Getty.AAT.md): Authoritex implementation for the Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus (AAT)
- [Authoritex.Getty.Base](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.Getty.Base.md): Abstract Authoritex implementation for Getty authorities & vocabularies
- [Authoritex.Getty.TGN](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.Getty.TGN.md): Authoritex implementation for the Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names (TGN)
- [Authoritex.Getty.ULAN](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.Getty.ULAN.md): Authoritex implementation for the Getty Union List of Artist Names (ULAN)
- [Authoritex.HTTP.Auth](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.HTTP.Auth.md): Module for handling HTTP authentication for Authoritex authorities.

- [Authoritex.HTTP.Client](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.HTTP.Client.md): HTTP client for Authoritex
- [Authoritex.Homosaurus](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.Homosaurus.md): Authoritex implementation for Homosaurus linked data vocabulary
- [Authoritex.LOC](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.LOC.md): Authoritex implementation for Library of Congress Linked Data
- [Authoritex.LOC.Base](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.LOC.Base.md): Abstract Authoritex implementation for Library of Congress authorities & vocabularies
- [Authoritex.LOC.GenreForms](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.LOC.GenreForms.md): Authoritex implementation for Library of Congress Genre/Form Terms
- [Authoritex.LOC.Languages](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.LOC.Languages.md): Authoritex implementation for Library of Congress MARC List for Languages
- [Authoritex.LOC.Names](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.LOC.Names.md): Authoritex implementation for Library of Congress Name Authority File
- [Authoritex.LOC.SubjectHeadings](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.LOC.SubjectHeadings.md): Authoritex implementation for Library of Congress Subject Headings
- [Authoritex.Mock](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.Mock.md): Mock Authority for testing Authoritex consumers
- [Authoritex.OpenSearch](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.OpenSearch.md): Abstract authority that allows using OpenSearch as a backend.
- [Authoritex.TestCase](https://authoritex.hexdocs.pm/Authoritex.TestCase.md): Shared tests for Authoritex modules
